title: Diablo: Original Game Development
summary: David Brevik's GDC 2016 post-mortem of the original Diablo, covering how it evolved from a turn-based claymation DOS game into the genre-defining action RPG. It includes development anecdotes and lessons learned.
why: HN considers it one of the best GDC post-mortems, with funny anecdotes (such as turning down Hotmail equity) and multiplayer insights.

quote.text: GDC post mortems are amazing, especially the ones on Diablo[0] and Fallout[1].
